text.p: Macheezmo Mouse Restaurants Inc on Friday posted weak second quarter results and said it is considering all its strategic alternatives.

"The company will move aggressively to reduce expenses to levels commensurate with current revenues," said Chairman William Warren. "In light of the strategic consolidation in our industry, we are considering all strategic alternatives."
Macheezmo Mouse said it lost $566,000, or $0.14 a share in its second quarter compared with a net loss of $397,000, or $0.10 a share in the year-ago period.
Second quarter revenues were $1.677 million compared with $2.069 million in the year-ago period.
Same restaurant net sales were 14 percent below the prior year's second quarter. Macheezmo Mouse said that historically, the second quarter is its weakest quarter.
Macheezmo Mouse operates 19 Mexican food restaurants throughout Oregon and Washington.
